## Specific task description

Task instruction: Press the stapler the hand-size bright blue stapler with the arm the left arm.

Task description: The target is the palm-sized bright blue stapler at the front left of the table. Use the left arm to press it into contact.

Success criteria: The left gripper must make actual contact near the stapler's target press position, close to it both horizontally and in height. Hovering above it or touching a part far from the target is insufficient.

## Execution tips

- Reduce the gripper opening to fit the lid width so the pads land on the flat area of the blue top cover. Avoid the edges where possible to reduce fingers passing over empty space or slipping after contact.
- Contact the top cover from above, nearly vertically if possible, avoiding oblique contact with the side wall so the force is directed mostly downward.
- Near the lid, reduce the downward movement and adjust based on actual contact. Avoid continuing to press deeply just because no visible deformation has occurred.
